bagPolicy.summary: Dickies Arena does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly detailed on the provided page. Visitors are encouraged to check the official website for updates on parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: Guests who are using ride share services should be dropped off at the west entrance of the arena, in the drop off lane at Dickies Way. Guests can be picked up for ride share on Harley Avenue, which is located on the north end of the building.

concessions.note: Dickies Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options for event attendees, including traditional concession stands and specialty vendors. Guests can enjoy a range of snacks, meals, and drinks to enhance their event experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Dickies Arena has a Sensory Needs Room, which is located on the northwest corner of the 200 level. If you require accessible seating and you have tickets in a non-accessible seating location, please contact the Dickies Arena Box Office at 817-402-9801 as soon as possible for accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Dickies Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Dickies Arena Box Office is located at 1911 Montgomery Street, on the southwest side of the venue and across from the Chevrolet Parking Garage. To purchase tickets for an upcoming event, please visit Ticketmaster.com or go to the Dickies Arena Box Office at 1911 Montgomery Street.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Dickies Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
